details.pattern: Paper-I: 200 Q (GK, Reasoning + Engineering). Paper-II: Engineering (300 marks).
details.syllabus: Civil / Electrical / Mechanical Engineering, GK, Reasoning

notes: ROUND 3 (2026-11-21). 2025 was already fully covered in round 2 (official + Testbook/Prepp/Adda247/Guidely/CareerPower) — nothing new added for 2025. Round 3 deepens the THIN years 2018 and 2020 as tasked: JagranJosh lists Jan 2018 Paper-I shifts (22-29 Jan 2018, Morning/Evening, Civil/Electrical/Mechanical); SSCAdda has branch-wise 2018 + 2020-21 Paper-I PDFs and a Paper-II 2007-2018 compilation (only Paper-II source found); Oliveboard has branch-wise 2020-cycle papers (held Mar 2021). Note on dating: JE cycles are named by notification year; 2018-cycle Paper-I was held Jan 2018, 2020-cycle Paper-I was held Mar 2021 — years below follow the cycle/notification year used by the sources and the live site. JE Paper-II 2025 was scheduled 7 Apr 2026 per round 2; not re-verified in round 3 (no Paper-II 2025 paper added). No YouTube added in round 3 (rounds 1+2 already have 5 videos).
